authorities.fact: local administrator credential verifier and authentication state
per-run authenticated runtime identity and trusted-control evidence
sensitive-field classification and diagnostic sanitization policy

consumers: HLD-13 diagnostics may correlate but never redefine

identity_rules: Authentication identity is the singleton Local Administrator identity; Contacts are never login identities.
A password/verifier is not a data-encryption key, backup recovery key, run-auth token or device credential.
PID, port, registry-file presence or loopback origin alone never establish trusted run identity.
Opaque diagnostic correlation identifiers are purpose-created and do not reuse secrets or sensitive business identifiers unnecessarily.
